en: The Therāpadāna: The Chapter on the Giver of Leaves (Paṇṇadāyakavagga) 5. The Apadāna of the Elder Maghavapupphiya [Verse 1] I offered a single flower to the Buddha, the Great Sage, who was wandering through the world for the welfare of all beings. [Verse 2] Through that root of merit, I have attained a human birth; having been born as a human, I have now become a monk. [Verse 3] For eighty-four thousand aeons, I dwelt in the realm of the Thirty-Three [Devas]; there I enjoyed the five kinds of divine sensual pleasures. [Verse 4] In my final existence, I was born into a wealthy family; endowed with great wealth, I lived in the city of Sāvatthī. [Verse 5] I gave alms-food to the Teacher, the Fully Enlightened One, together with his retinue of monks, while he was traveling through the Kosala country. [Verse 6] Having performed this deed, I passed away from that life and was reborn in the Brahma-world, where I shone with a radiance like that of the sun. [Verse 7] From there, passing through various realms of existence, I have wandered through the cycle of rebirths; yet I have never experienced suffering, nor have I ever known the state of being a woman. [Verse 8] Now, in my final birth, I have become a monk; having abandoned the five lower fetters, I am no longer subject to rebirth in the womb.

[Verse 9] With the destruction of the three fetters, I am a "Stream-enterer" (Sotāpanna), no longer subject to falling back, destined for enlightenment, and certain to attain final Nibbāna after seven more births at most. [Verse 10] I have reached the stage of a "Once-returner" (Sakadāgāmin); having returned to this world only once more, I shall put an end to suffering. [Verse 11] I have reached the stage of a "Non-returner" (Anāgāmin); having completely transcended the realm of sense-desire, I shall not return again to this world. [Verse 12] I have reached the stage of an Arhat; having destroyed all defilements, I am liberated through perfect knowledge. My burden is laid down, my task is accomplished, and my existence is brought to an end. [Verse 13] I have attained the supreme fruit of the holy life; I have realized the goal for which I went forth from the household life into homelessness. [Verse 14] I have seen the Dhamma with my own eyes; I have attained the deathless state. Having heard the teaching of the Teacher, I have crossed over the ocean of saṃsāra. [Verse 15] I have attained the peaceful state, free from fear; I have reached the island of safety, the refuge, and the ultimate goal. [Verse 16] I have attained the state of peace, the cessation of all formations; I have reached the cool state, the unconditioned, the sorrowless, and the stainless. [Verse 17] I have attained the state of liberation, the state of the Tathāgatas; I have reached the state of the Arahants, the state of the Buddhas, and the state of the Well-Gone Ones. [Verse 18] I have attained the state of the Conquerors, the state of the Self-Conquerors; I have reached the state of the Great Conquerors, the state of the Victorious Ones, and the state of the Invincible Ones. [Verse 19] I have attained the state of the Blessed Ones, the state of the Fully Enlightened Ones; I have reached the state of the All-Knowing Ones, the state of the All-Seers, and the state of the All-Pervading Ones. [Verse 20] I have attained the state of the All-Awakened Ones, the state of the Perfectly Awakened Ones; I have reached the state of the Unsurpassed Ones, the state of the Peerless Ones, and the state of the Incomparable Ones. [Verse 21] I have attained the state of the Unrivalled Ones, the state of the Matchless Ones; I have reached the state of the Unequaled Ones, the state of the Incomparable Ones, and the state of the Unrivaled Ones. [Verse 22] I have attained the state of the Peerless Ones, the state of the Incomparable Ones; I have reached the state of the Unmatched Ones, the state of the Unrivalled Ones, and the state of the Unconquerable Ones. [Verse 23] I have attained the state of the Unassailable Ones, the state of the Unshakeable Ones; I have reached the state of the Unfettered Ones, the state of the Unbound Ones, and the state of the Unattached Ones. [Verse 24] I have attained the state of the Unstained Ones, the state of the Pure Ones; I have reached the state of the Stainless Ones, the state of the Spotless Ones, and the state of the Immaculate Ones. [Verse 25] I have attained the state of the Bright Ones, the state of the Radiant Ones; I have reached the state of the Luminous Ones, the state of the Effulgent Ones, and the state of the Glorious Ones. [Verse 26] I have attained the state of the Splendid Ones, the state of the Majestic Ones; I have reached the state of the Resplendent Ones, the state of the Glorious Ones, and the state of the Exalted Ones. [Verse 27] I have attained the state of the Noble Ones, the state of the Sublime Ones; I have reached the state of the Excellent Ones, the state of the Worthy Ones, and the state of the Honorable Ones. [Verse 28] I have attained the state of the Venerable Ones, the state of the Revered Ones; I have reached the state of the Esteemed Ones, the state of the Honored Ones, and the state of the Adored Ones. [Verse 29] I have attained the state of the Praiseworthy Ones, the state of the Laudable Ones; I have reached the state of the Praise-worthy Ones, the state of the Commendable Ones, and the state of the Eulogized Ones. [Verse 30] I have attained the state of the Glorified Ones, the state of the Celebrated Ones; I have reached the state of the Famed Ones, the state of the Illustrious Ones, and the state of the Renowned Ones.

[Verse 31] I have attained the state of the Celebrated Ones, the state of the Glorified Ones; I have reached the state of the Praised Ones, the state of the Honored Ones, and the state of the Adored Ones. [Verse 32] I have attained the state of the Venerated Ones, the state of the Revered Ones; I have reached the state of the Honored Ones, the state of the Esteemed Ones, and the state of the Adored Ones. [Verse 33] I have attained the state of the Worshipped Ones, the state of the Adored Ones; I have reached the state of the Honored Ones, the state of the Esteemed Ones, and the state of the Venerated Ones. [Verse 34] I have attained the state of the Honored Ones, the state of the Esteemed Ones; I have reached the state of the Venerated Ones, the state of the Worshipped Ones, and the state of the Adored Ones. [Verse 35] I have attained the state of the Adored Ones, the state of the Worshipped Ones; I have reached the state of the Honored Ones, the state of the Esteemed Ones, and the state of the Venerated Ones. [Verse 36] I have attained the state of the Esteemed Ones, the state of the Venerated Ones; I have reached the state of the Worshipped Ones, the state of the Adored Ones, and the state of the Honored Ones. [Verse 37] I have attained the state of the Venerated Ones, the state of the Worshipped Ones; I have reached the state of the Adored Ones, the state of the Esteemed Ones, and the state of the Honored Ones. [Verse 38] I have attained the state of the Honored Ones, the state of the Esteemed Ones; I have reached the state of the Venerated Ones, the state of the Worshipped Ones, and the state of the Adored Ones. [Verse 39] I have attained the state of the Adored Ones, the state of the Esteemed Ones; I have reached the state of the Honored Ones, the state of the Venerated Ones, and the state of the Worshipped Ones. [Verse 40] I have attained the
On the bank of the Nammadā River,
Having seen the unconquered Sambuddha, his mind was serene and joyful.
I then worshipped the Self-Existent One.
Because I offered that flower in worship,
I do not know a state of misery;
this is the fruit of worshipping the Buddha.
[and so on] ...the Buddha’s teaching has been accomplished.
Thus indeed the venerable elder Maghavapupphiya spoke these verses.
This is the fifth legend of the elder Maghavapupphiya.
